title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Onto-norms and Gender Equality: Unveiling the Invisible Gender Norms in AI Ecosystems in the Context of Africa
reasoning: The paper uses 'onto-norms' and 'epistemic injustice' as core theoretical frameworks to evaluate AI ecosystems. It also discusses the role of African ethics, religious beliefs, and cultural morals in shaping the social ontologies that lead to algorithmic bias.
